verdict.rationale: Foreloop's agent model works via developer checkouts polling for approved tasks and PR review gates (advisory checks, retest via comment), but there is no evidence of a CI/CD-triggered workflow where a build/test failure spawns or invokes an agent to fix it. The CLI's scriptability (usable from cron/agents) and MCP endpoint are generic, not documented as a CI/CD build-failure remediation trigger.
